subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should Gateway adopt this PR's default-on post-clean-shutdown forced exit and strict internal /healthz?strict=1 lock-recovery contract for supervised installs?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well covered, but the remaining choice is an operator-facing runtime policy decision about process termination, health semantics, and the new timeout env surface.

options.title: Accept default-on recovery
options.body: Approve the 5s forced-exit watchdog and strict internal probe as the default supervisor recovery behavior after exact-head CI and merge-result review stay green.

options.title: Require a narrower operator surface
options.body: Ask for an opt-in mode, documented env control, or adjusted default before merge if owners are not ready to make forced exit default-on.

options.title: Pause for a supervisor-only design
options.body: Hold or close this branch if owners prefer launchd/systemd/doctor recovery rather than in-process watchdog behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on recovery
recommendation.body: Approve the 5s forced-exit watchdog and strict internal probe as the default supervisor recovery behavior after exact-head CI and merge-result review stay green.
